headline: China Offers C$400 Million in Tariff Relief to Canada
summary: China granted C$400 million in tariff relief to Canada as key global economies adjust their trading arrangements in response to heightened US trade pressure.
why: Shifts in bilateral tariff policy between Beijing and Ottawa affect Canadian agricultural and commodity exporters seeking diversified alternatives to US market demand.

impacts.name: S&P/TSX Composite
impacts.why: C$400 million in Chinese tariff concessions provides modest support for Canadian exporting sectors.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
